The WSJ reports that as AI giants rack up potential legal liabilities of tens of billions of dollars amid safety incidents, insurers worry that claims could outpace the limits on existing coverage.
The growth rate of the AI industry is the core problem for underwriters: exposure is compounding faster than policy limits and actuarial models can absorb.
highlights: WSJ: AI giants face potential legal liabilities in the tens of billions
Insurers worry claims may outpace existing coverage limits
Safety incidents are driving the exposure
